issue.title: Agents-sync publisher hashes --mon transcripts that keep growing before snapshot publication, causing transient hood quarantines
issue.description:
The agents-sync publisher computes a hood package's content digests at snapshot time
while member transcripts can still be growing, so the bytes later copied into the
publication can differ from the manifest digest. Importing machines then quarantine the
hood with a digest-mismatch diagnostic that looks like corruption but is a transient
race artifact.

Evidence (athena agent sync repair research, verified 2026-09-02): 15 hood packages,
all with `--mon` members, were quarantined on an importing machine for chat.md digest
mismatches. Refetching the sidecar showed the current bytes for
`agents/bbugyi200.athena.03w--mon/chat.md` match the manifest digest exactly (93,956
bytes, identical sha256), i.e. the mismatch self-healed on the next publish — consistent
with a monitor transcript that grew between content hashing and snapshot publication on
the source machine, and inconsistent with durable corruption. The stale quarantine
diagnostics persist in the importer's local cache until a revalidation pass.

Fix direction from the research: hash the bytes actually copied into the publication
(read once, hash and write from the same buffer), or exclude still-running members from
the snapshot. The importer-side revalidation that clears stale quarantines is separate
work (batched-sidecar-reads phase of the athena agent sync repair epic); this bead is
the publisher-side race so the window stops recurring.

task_type_fields.impact: Importing machines quarantine affected hoods until revalidation, so recently-active monitor families intermittently fail to sync; stale quarantine diagnostics persist locally and erode trust in real digest failures.
task_type_fields.location: src/sase/agents_sync/ publisher snapshot/digest computation (owner-manifest content digests for hood member files, e.g. chat.md of --mon members)
task_type_fields.repro: Not deterministically reproducible on demand (race). Observed: 15 hoods with --mon members quarantined for chat.md digest mismatch on an importing machine; refetching the sidecar on 2026-09-02 showed agents/bbugyi200.athena.03w--mon/chat.md bytes matching the manifest digest exactly (93,956 bytes, identical sha256). Publish a snapshot while a monitor member's transcript is actively growing to hit the window.
